333.name: Quest: Rite Of The Forge God

1002.name: Apex Inventor
1002.desc:
Gain 100 Item Haste (equivalent to 50% Item CDR).

Item Haste reduces the cooldown %i:cooldown% of all Item Abilities.

1004.name: Back To Basics
1004.desc: Gain increased Ability Damage, <healing>Healing</healing>, <shield>Shielding</shield>, and <scaleAbilityHaste>Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste>, but you <keywordMajor>cannot use your Ultimate Ability</keywordMajor>.

1006.name: Blade Waltz
1006.desc: Gain <spellName>Blade Waltz</spellName> as a Summoner Spell.

1009.name: Buff Buddies
1009.desc:
You gain Crest of Cinders and Crest of Insight.

Granting yourself Ability Haste and resource regeneration and causing your Attacks to Burn and Slow enemy champions.

1011.name: Can't Touch This
1011.desc: Casting your <attention>Ultimate</attention> makes you <keywordMajor>Invulnerable</keywordMajor> for a short duration.

1013.name: Celestial Body
1013.desc: Gain <scaleHealth>1500 Health</scaleHealth>, but you deal 10% less damage.

1015.name: Circle of Death
1015.desc: <healing>Healing</healing> and <healing>Health Regen</healing> also deals <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> to the nearest enemy champion.

1018.name: Courage of the Colossus
1018.desc: Gain <shield>(150 - 450 + 4%%i:scaleHealth%) Shield</shield> after <status>Immobilizing</status> or <status>Grounding</status> an enemy champion.

1019.name: Dashing
1019.desc: Your dash, leap, blink, or teleport Abilities gain <scaleAbilityHaste>175 Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste>.

1020.name: Dawnbringer's Resolve
1020.desc:
When dropping below 50% Health, heal for 35% max Health over 3 seconds.
Resets on death or every 45 seconds.

1023.name: Demon's Dance
1023.desc: Gain the <spellName>Fleet Footwork</spellName> and <spellName>Grasp of the Undying</spellName> Keystone Runes.

1025.name: Dive Bomber
1025.desc: Explodes when you die, dealing <trueDamage>massive true damage</trueDamage>.

1026.name: Don't Blink
1026.desc: Gain 1% bonus damage per <speed>10 Move Speed</speed> you have more than the target.

1027.name: Earthwake
1027.desc: Your dash, blink, or teleport Abilities leave behind a trail that detonates after 0.75 second.

1028.name: Erosion
1028.desc: Damaging enemies adds a stacking <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> shred for 4s.

1029.name: Ethereal Weapon
1029.desc: Your Abilities apply %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> effects. 1 second Cooldown per target.

1030.name: Eureka
1030.desc: Gain <scaleAbilityHaste>Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste> equal to <scaleAP>30% Ability Power</scaleAP>.

1032.name: Executioner
1032.desc: Deal 10% more damage to enemies below 30% Health. Reset your basic Abilities on takedown.

1034.name: Veil of Warding
1034.desc: Gain a <attention>Spell Shield</attention> every 30 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability.

1035.name: Feel the Burn
1035.desc:
Gain the Feel the Burn Summoner Spell.

Feel the Burn casts Ignite and Exhaust on all nearby enemy champions.

1036.name: Firebrand
1036.desc: Your Attacks apply an infinitely stacking <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing damage over time.

1038.name: From Beginning To End
1038.desc: Gain the <spellName>First Strike</spellName> and <spellName>Dark Harvest</spellName> Keystone Runes.

1039.name: Frost Wraith
1039.desc: <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> <status>Root</status> nearby enemies for 1.25 seconds every 6.5 seconds.

1041.name: Goliath
1041.desc: Become large, gaining <scaleHealth>35% Health</scaleHealth> and <scaleAF>15% Adaptive Force</scaleAF>.

1044.name: Ice Cold
1044.desc: Your <status>Slowing</status> effects reduce <speed>Movement Speed</speed> by an extra 75.

1045.name: Infernal Conduit
1045.desc:
Your Abilities apply stacking Burn that deals damage over time.

Your Burn effects reduce your basic Ability Cooldowns.

1046.name: Infernal Soul
1046.desc: You gain the Infernal Dragon Soul, dealing bonus damage when you hit enemies with Abilities or Attacks.

1048.name: Jeweled Gauntlet
1048.desc:
Your Abilities can Critically Strike.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% (25% + 4.5%%i:scaleAP%) Crit Chance.

1050.name: Keystone Conjurer
1050.desc: Gain the <spellName>Summon Aery</spellName> and <spellName>Arcane Comet</spellName> Keystone Runes.

1051.name: Light 'Em Up!
1051.desc: Every 4th Attack shoots 4 missiles dealing <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>.

1052.name: Lightning Strikes
1052.desc:
Gain 20% total Attack Speed.

At 1.75 Attacks per second, deal additional magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.

1053.name: Mad Scientist
1053.desc: On each Revive, you grow large (gaining <font color = '#8347ff'>Adaptive Force</font> and <scaleHealth>Health</scaleHealth>) or tiny (gaining Ability Haste and <speed>Movement Speed</speed>).

1054.name: Master of Duality
1054.desc: Your Attacks grant you stacking <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP> and your Abilities that damage enemies grant you <scaleAD>Attack Damage</scaleAD>.

1056.name: Mind to Matter
1056.desc: Increase <scaleHealth>max Health</scaleHealth> by half of your <scaleMana>max Mana</scaleMana>.

1057.name: Mountain Soul
1057.desc: You gain the Mountain Soul, gaining a <shield>Shield</shield> after being out of combat for a short time.

1058.name: Mystic Punch
1058.desc: %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> reduce the cooldown of your abilities by 1.25 seconds %i:scaleCooldown%.

1060.name: Ocean Soul
1060.desc: Gain the Ocean Soul, granting high <healing>Health</healing> and <scaleMana>Mana</scaleMana> regen after damaging enemies.

1061.name: Ok Boomerang
1061.desc: <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> throw a boomerang at a nearby enemy every 7 seconds.

1063.name: Outlaw's Grit
1063.desc: After using a Dash, Blink, or Teleport Ability you gain <scaleArmor>12 Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> up to 5 stacks.

1064.name: Perseverance
1064.desc: Gain hugely increased <healing>Health Regen</healing>, further increased at low <scaleHealth>Health</scaleHealth>.

1066.name: Quantum Computing
1066.desc: Periodically <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a massive slash. Enemies hit are <status>Slowed</status>, take additional <physicalDamage>max Health damage</physicalDamage>, and heal you.

1069.name: Repulsor
1069.desc: On dropping below 35% Health, <status>Knock Back</status> nearby enemies and <status>Slow</status> them for 90%.

1072.name: Searing Dawn
1072.desc: Your Abilities mark enemies, causing them to take additional <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> from your ally's next Attack or Ability.

1073.name: Shadow Runner
1073.desc: After using a Dash, Blink, or Teleport Ability or exiting <stealth>Stealth</stealth>, gain <speed>Movement Speed</speed>.

1074.name: Shrink Ray
1074.desc: Your Attacks reduce the target's damage and size by 15% %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>.

1075.name: Slow Cooker
1075.desc: Every second, apply an infinitely stacking <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> to nearby enemy champions, scaling with your <scaleHealth>max Health</scaleHealth>.

1076.name: Sonic Boom
1076.desc: Buffing, <healing>Healing</healing>, or <shield>Shielding</shield> your ally deals damage and <status>Slows</status> enemies surrounding them.

1077.name: Soul Siphon
1077.desc:
Heal for 12% of damage done by Critical Strikes.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% Crit chance.

1079.name: Symphony of War
1079.desc: Gain the <spellName>Lethal Tempo</spellName> and <spellName>Conqueror</spellName> Keystone Runes.

1080.name: Tank It Or Leave It
1080.desc:
You can Critically Defend using your Crit Chance (max 50% chance), giving you a chance to reduce damage.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% Crit Chance.

1081.name: Tap Dancer
1081.desc: Your Attacks grant you <speed>Movement Speed</speed>. Gain <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> based on your Movement Speed.

1082.name: The Brutalizer
1082.desc: Gain <scaleAD>20 Attack Damage</scaleAD>, 10 Ability Haste, and <scaleLethality>5 Lethality</scaleLethality>.

1084.name: Thread the Needle
1084.desc: Gain 18% <armorPen>%i:scaleAPen% Armor Penetration</armorPen> and <magicPen>%i:scaleMPen% Magic Penetration</magicPen>.

1085.name: Tormentor
1085.desc: <status>Immobilizing</status> or <status>Grounding</status> enemy champions applies a <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> that deals damage over time, stacking infinitely.

1086.name: Trueshot Prodigy
1086.desc: When you damage a champion from far away, fire a <abilityName>Trueshot Barrage</abilityName> at them.

1087.name: Typhoon
1087.desc: Your Attacks shoot a missile at an additional target, dealing reduced damage and applying %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> effects.

1088.name: Ultimate Revolution
1088.desc: Refresh your <attention>Ultimate</attention> after casting it (75 seconds Cooldown or reset on death).

1092.name: Vulnerability
1092.desc:
Your Item and damage over time effects can Critically Strike.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% Crit chance.

1095.name: Windspeaker's Blessing
1095.desc: Your <healing>Healing</healing> and <shield>Shielding</shield> also increases the target's <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for 3 seconds.

1098.name: With Haste
1098.desc: Gain <speed>Move Speed</speed> equal to 70% of your Ability Haste.

1104.name: Minionmancer
1104.desc: Your summons gain 40% increased size, health, and damage.

1105.name: Homeguard
1105.desc: Gain <speed>100% Movement Speed</speed>, disabled for 6 seconds after taking damage.

1107.name: Twice Thrice
1107.desc: Every 3 attacks, your %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> effects trigger a second time.

1108.name: Self Destruct
1108.desc: Every 25 seconds, attach a bomb to you. After 5 seconds, it explodes for <trueDamage>true damage</trueDamage> and <status>Knocks Up</status> enemies.

1112.name: Ultimate Unstoppable
1112.desc: After using your Ultimate, you become immune to <status>crowd control</status> for 3 seconds. (8 second Cooldown).

1113.name: Skilled Sniper
1113.desc: <keywordMajor>Snipe</keywordMajor> an enemy with a non-Ultimate Ability refunds 80% Cooldown (65% for periodic Abilities).

1116.name: Flashy
1116.desc: Your Flash has 3 charges. After 120 seconds, regain all charges.

1118.name: Critical Healing
1118.desc: Your <healing>healing</healing> and <shield>Shields</shield> can Critically Strike for 40% bonus amount. Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% Crit Chance.

1129.name: Marksmage
1129.desc: Your Attacks deal additional <physicalDamage>physical damage</physicalDamage> equal to <scaleAP>75% Ability Power</scaleAP>.

1133.name: Magic Missile
1133.desc: Dealing Ability damage fires 3 missiles, each dealing <trueDamage>percent max Health true damage</trueDamage> based on distance traveled.

1134.name: Draw Your Sword
1134.desc: Become melee and gain <physicalDamage>Attack Damage</physicalDamage>, <healing>Health</healing>, <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, <lifesteal>Lifesteal</lifesteal>, and <speed>Movement Speed</speed> (scaling with the range you give up).

1136.name: Slap Around
1136.desc: Gain 10 Adaptive Force when you <status>Immobilize</status> or <status>Ground</status> an enemy. Lose 50% on death.

1141.name: All For You
1141.desc: Your <healing>Heals</healing> and <shield>Shields</shield> are stronger when used on an ally.

1149.name: Impassable
1149.desc: Gain the <spellName>Aftershock</spellName> and <spellName>Glacial Augment</spellName> Keystone Runes.

1152.name: Quest: Steel Your Heart
1152.desc:
QUEST: Possess Heartsteel with 300+ stacks.

REWARD: Multiply your Heartsteel stacks by 3.

1156.name: Quest: Wooglet's Witchcap
1156.desc:
Immediately gain a Needlessly Large Rod.

QUEST: Possess Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass.

REWARD: Gain Wooglet's Witchcap.

1180.name: Big Brain
1180.desc: Gain<shield> 3 Shield </shield>for every <scaleAP>%i:scaleAP% 1 Ability Power</scaleAP>. Resets on death or 70 seconds after depletion.

1181.name: Heavy Hitter
1181.desc: Your Attacks deal additional <physicalDamage>physical damage</physicalDamage> equal to 3.5% of your <scaleHealth>max Health.</scaleHealth>

1187.name: Flashbang
1187.desc: Your Flash causes an explosion that damages and <status>Slows</status> (resets on death).

1194.name: Fey Magic
1194.desc: Damaging with your <attention>Ultimate</attention> <status>Polymorphs</status> enemies for a few seconds.

1195.name: Giant Slayer
1195.desc: Become tiny, gain <speed>Movement Speed</speed>, and gain bonus damage to champions based on how much larger they are than you.

1198.name: Holy Fire
1198.desc: <healing>Healing</healing> or <shield>Shielding</shield> applies an infinitely stacking <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> to a nearby enemy, dealing <magicDamage>percent max Health magic damage</magicDamage> over a few seconds.

1204.name: Stackosaurus Rex
1204.desc: When you gain permanent <keywordMajor>Stacks</keywordMajor> of an Ability, gain 100% more!

1205.name: ADAPt
1205.desc: Convert <scaleAD>Bonus Attack Damage</scaleAD> to <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>. Gain <scaleAP>15% Ability Power</scaleAP>.

1206.name: escAPADe
1206.desc: Convert <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP> to <scaleAD>Bonus Attack Damage</scaleAD>. Gain <scaleAD>15% Attack Damage</scaleAD>.

1211.name: It's Killing Time
1211.desc: After casting your Ultimate, mark all enemies and store up damage you deal to them. When it ends, detonate the damage.

1214.name: Spin To Win
1214.desc: Your spin Abilities gain %i:scaleAH%30 Ability Haste and deal 30% more damage, increase to 50% for Ultimates

1220.name: Fan The Hammer
1220.desc: Attacks against enemy champions fire 5 missiles that deal more damage with distance. Each direction has its own Cooldown.

1225.name: Dual Wield
1225.desc: Attacks fire a bolt that applies %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> effects at reduced strength. Gain <attackSpeed>10% total Attack Speed</attackSpeed>.

1250.name: Slow And Steady
1250.desc: Your <speed>Attack Speed</speed> becomes 0.63. All Bonus <speed>Attack Speed</speed> is converted to <scaleAD>Attack Damage</scaleAD>. (<scaleAD>25 Plus 1 AD</scaleAD> per <speed>1% AS</speed>).

1301.name: Divine Intervention
1301.desc: Every 35 seconds, <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a protective star. Upon its landing, you and nearby allies become <keywordMajor>Invulnerable</keywordMajor> for a few seconds.

1305.name: Leg Day
1305.desc: Gain <speed>50 Movement Speed</speed> and <speed>50% Slow Resist</speed>.

1308.name: FireFox
1308.desc:
Autocast
Gain Movement Speed and conjure three flames that orbit you, targetting the closest visible enemy in range and dealing magic damage.

1310.name: Clown College
1310.desc:
Gain Deceive Summoner Spell.
Gain Backstab Passive.

When you die, deal a large amount of true damage and Fear nearby enemies.

1311.name: Overflow
1311.desc:
Your Mana costs are doubled.

Your Ability Heals, Shields, and damage are increased based on your max Mana.

1313.name: Cheating
1313.desc: Press Recall to return to base, buy items, and acquire augments.

1314.name: Mighty Shield
1314.desc: Gain %i:miniAdaptiveForce%<font color = '#8347ff'>40 - 100 Adaptive Force</font> for 3 seconds when you gain a Shield (5 seconds Cooldown).

1315.name: Swift and Safe
1315.desc: Gain a <shield>Shield</shield> after a Dash or Blink.

1316.name: Wind Beneath Blade
1316.desc: The higher your <armorPen>Armor Penetration</armorPen> and <magicPen>Magic Penetration</magicPen> are, the faster you are.

1318.name: Upgrade Zhonya's
1318.desc:
Reduce Zhonya's Hourglass Cooldown to 45 seconds. You can now move and gain Movement Speed when in Zhonya's Hourglass, Seeker's Armguard, or Wooglet's Witchcap stasis.

Gain 250 Gold.

1319.name: Upgrade Immolate
1319.desc: <attention>Hollow Radiance</attention> and <attention>Sunfire Aegis</attention> grant <gold>12 Gold</gold> per target affected with Immolate. Gain <gold>250 Gold</gold>.

1320.name: Upgrade Collector
1320.desc:
Executing enemies with The Collector's Passive increases its execute threshold and grants bonus Gold.
Gain 250 Gold.

1321.name: Gash
1321.desc: Gain 50% <speed>Attack Speed</speed>. Deal True Damage %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, scaling with your %i:scaleArmor% Armor.

1322.name: Get Excited!
1322.desc: Increase <speed>Movement Speed</speed> and <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for 4 seconds on takedown.

1323.name: Cruelty
1323.desc: On <status>Immobilizing</status> or <status>Grounding</status> a champion, summon a comet that lands after a delay, dealing <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies.

1324.name: Protein Shake
1324.desc: Gain <healing>%i:scaleHealShield%(25 + 35% bonus%i:scaleArmor% + 35% bonus%i:scaleMR%)% Heal and Shield Power</healing> based on bonus <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.

1325.name: Glass Cannon
1325.desc: Reduce <scaleHealth>max Health by 30%</scaleHealth>. Deal an extra 25% damage as <trueDamage>true damage</trueDamage>.

1326.name: Nightstalking
1326.desc: Takedowns against enemy champions within 3 seconds of damaging them grants you <speed>Movement Speed</speed> and renders you invisible.

1327.name: Adamant
1327.desc: Each time you <status>Immobilize</status> or <status>Ground</status> an enemy, gain <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.

1328.name: Critical Rhythm
1328.desc:
Your basic Attack stacks Attack Speed on Critical Strikes.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% Crit chance.

1329.name: Biggest Snowball Ever
1329.desc:
Gain 100 Ability Haste on Snowball.

Your snowball is BIG and will pass through minions. It Slows, Knocks Up champions, and deals additional damage.

If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

1330.name: ReEnergize
1330.desc: Gain an <keyword>Energized Attack</keyword> that deals <magicDamage>10% target current Health</magicDamage>. Charges are fully refunded if the target is not the same as your previous.

1331.name: Empyrean Promise
1331.desc:
Gain %i:scaleHealShield% 15% Heal and Shield power. Gain Empyrean Promise as a Summoner Spell.

Vigilance
Teleport to an ally and grant (100 - 250 + 100%%i:scaleAP% + 10% bonus%i:scaleHealth%) Shield for 3 seconds after landing.

1332.name: Ominous Pact
1332.desc: Gain <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>, <speed>Movement Speed</speed>, and <omnivamp>Omnivamp</omnivamp> based on <scaleHealth>missing Health</scaleHealth>, taking damage each time you cast.

1333.name: Escape Plan
1333.desc: Gain a massive <shield>decaying Shield</shield>, decaying <speed>Movement Speed</speed>, and a decaying shrink effect upon reaching <scaleHealth>35% Health</scaleHealth>.

1334.name: Snowball Upgrade
1334.desc:
Gain 50 Ability Haste on Snowball. Hitting an enemy creates a snowfall that deals AoE damage and Slows nearby enemies.

If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

1335.name: Goldrend
1335.desc: Damaging a champion with Attacks or Abilities deals additional <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage>, and grants you <gold>Gold</gold> and <speed>Movement Speed</speed>.

1336.name: Upgrade Infinity Edge
1336.desc:
Gain 500 Gold.
Having Infinity Edge allows your %i:scaleCrit% Critical Strike Chance to grant random %i:scaleCritMult% Critical Strike Damage each Attack.

1337.name: King Me
1337.desc: The first time you take the enemy transport <attention>with a Legendary Item</attention> you become <font color = '#d158f9'>Kinged</font>, upgrading your item and gaining a random Prismatic Augment.

1338.name: Upgrade Hubris
1338.desc:
On Takedown, Hubris heals you and grants Movement Speed, scaling with your Eminence stacks.

Gain +%i:goldCoins% 250 Gold.

1339.name: Laser Heal
1339.desc: Cast a laser for 2.5 seconds that <scaleHealth>heals allies</scaleHealth>, and <status>Slows</status> and deals <scaleAP>magic damage</scaleAP> to enemies.

1340.name: Upgrade Mikael's Blessing
1340.desc:
Gain Mikael's Blessing. Reduce Mikael's Blessing Cooldown to 45 seconds.

On item active, cleanse Disabling and Immobilizing effects and Heal allies in range.

1341.name: Hat on a Hat
1341.desc: Headwear items and hats give an extra <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.

1342.name: Snowball Roulette
1342.desc:
Gain 100 Ability Haste on Snowball. Hitting an enemy casts a random beneficial Summoner Spell on you and a harmful one on them. Following up recast the beneficial one on yourself.

If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

1343.name: Sneakerhead
1343.desc:
Immediate: Gain a random pair of upgraded boots.

Requirement: Complete its quest to swap for another.

Reward: Jarvan I's Boot

1344.name: Final Form
1344.desc: After casting your <attention>Ultimate</attention>, gain a <shield>max Health Shield</shield>, <lifeSteal>Omnivamp</lifeSteal> and <speed>Movement Speed</speed> for 10 seconds.

1345.name: Spiritual Purification
1345.desc: On takedown, creates an explosion that <status>slows</status> other nearby enemies by 60%, and deals damage based on their <scaleHealth>current Health</scaleHealth>.

1346.name: Vampirism
1346.desc: You cannot be healed by allies or gain <healing>Health Regen</healing>. Gain <omnivamp>25%</omnivamp> Omnivamp.

1347.name: Poltergeist
1347.desc:
Gain Poltergeist as a Summoner Spell.

Poltergeist casts both Barrier and Ghost.

1348.name: Flash 2
1348.desc: Gain a second Flash Summoner Spell and 70 Summoner Haste.

1349.name: Ultimate Awakening
1349.desc:
Gain 30 Ultimate Ability Haste.
After using your Ultimate, refresh your basic abilities and gain 300 basic ability haste for 15s. (20s Cooldown)

1353.name: Tank Engine
1353.desc: On takedown, gain a stack that increases your size and <scaleHealth>max Health</scaleHealth>. Lose stacks on death.

1356.name: Critical Missile
1356.desc:
When you Critically Strike, fire missiles dealing magic damage.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% Crit chance.

1358.name: Pinball
1358.desc:
Your Snowball gains Ability Haste and deals extra True Damage.

When the Snowball bounces off walls, it increases in size and damage and has a reduced Cooldown.

1361.name: Quest: Icathia's Fall
1361.desc:
Immediately: Gain a Bami's Cinder.

QUEST: Possess Sunfire Aegis and Hollow Radiance.

REWARD: These Items combine into Void Immolation.

1372.name: I'm a Baby Kitty Where is Mama
1372.desc:
Standing next to an ally marks them as your mama.
Gain Movement Speed when moving towards Mama. Gain Movement Speed and heal and Shield Power when close to your mama.

1373.name: Shrink Engine
1373.desc:
Takedowns makes you smaller and grant Ability Haste and Movement Speed.

Lose 65% stacks on death.

1375.name: Soul Eater
1375.desc:
Immobilizing an enemy champion grants 30 max Health.

If taken as your second Augment, starts with 300 Health.

1379.name: Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn
1379.desc:
Gain 100% Attack Speed.

Increase Sword of Blossoming Dawn's healing to 250% when you attack enemy champions.

1384.name: Donation
1384.desc: Get <font color="#ffd138">1750</font> Gold. No questions asked.

1386.name: Spin Me Right Round
1386.desc:
Replace a Summoner Spell with Heroic Swing.

Heroic Swing fires a grappling hook, sticking into terrain, after which you can Recast to swing around it. While swinging, automatically Attack the nearest enemy. Colliding with an enemy champion or Recasting ends the swing.

1388.name: Infinite Recursion
1388.desc: Gain 60 Ability Haste, plus 3 Ability Haste per takedown.

1389.name: Hand of Baron
1389.desc: Gain <scaleAP>25% Adaptive Force</scaleAP>. Nearby allied minions are greatly empowered.

1390.name: Phenomenal Evil
1390.desc:
Permanently gain 1 Ability Power when you damage enemy champions with Abilities.

If taken as your second Augment, starts with 40 Ability Power.

1391.name: Red Envelopes
1391.desc: Red envelopes appear around you randomly. Picking them up gives you Gold and a small amount of a random Stats.

1392.name: Holy Snowball
1392.desc:
Gain 100 Ability Haste on Snowball.

You are briefly Invulnerable when you dash with Snowball.

If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

1397.name: Cerberus
1397.desc: Gain the <spellName>Hail of Blades</spellName> and <spellName>Press the Attack</spellName> Keystone Runes.

1400.name: Final City Transit
1400.desc: When you die, launch a train towards your killer, dealing <physicalDamage>(150 - 750 + 15%%i:scaleHealth% + 50%%i:scaleAP% + 65% bonus%i:scaleAD%) physical damage</physicalDamage> to enemies it hits. The train does not stop.

1401.name: Growth Spurt
1401.desc:
Gain Growth Spurt as a Summoner Spell.

Growth Spurt suddenly increases your size, Knocking Up nearby enemies and granting max Health.

1402.name: Stats on Stats on Stats!
1402.desc:
Gain 4 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils!

On your next Augment selection, gain one additional reroll per slot.

1403.name: Stats on Stats!
1403.desc: Gain 3 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils!

1405.name: Speed Demon
1405.desc: Gain <speed>200 Movement Speed</speed> when damaging an enemy champion with an Ability, decaying over 0.75 seconds.

1406.name: Grandma's Chili Oil
1406.desc:
Basic attacks and ability hits against enemies inflicts them with a Burn that drops a pool of Chili Oil nearby. Chili Oil restores Health and Burns enemies.

Chili Oil effects become stronger for each Burn you apply.

1409.name: Poro Blaster
1409.desc: You gather Poros over time. Damaging an enemy fires all Poros at them, each dealing <trueDamage>max Health true damage</trueDamage>. If you have 5 Poros, they will <status>Knock Back</status> once.

1411.name: Upgrade Thornmail
1411.desc: After 20 - 5 seconds out of combat, your Thornmail or Bramble Vest generates a shell that reflects increased damage from Attacks.

1413.name: Stuck In Here With Me
1413.desc:
Using your Ultimate Taunts nearby enemies and grants you damage reduction.

Gain 30 Ultimate Ability Haste.

1414.name: Droppybara
1414.desc:
Gain Droppybara as a Summoner Spell.

After a delay, call down a capybara that deals 30% max Health true damage.

1415.name: Twin Fire
1415.desc:
On ability damage, fire 1 plus 1 per 33.33%%i:scaleCrit% missiles that deal (10 - 30 + 7% bonus%i:scaleAD% + 7%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage each.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% Critical Strike Chance.

1416.name: Hextech Soul
1416.desc: Periodically your next damaging Ability or Attack triggers a lightning blast, chaining through enemies to deal damage and <status>Slow</status>.

1418.name: Crack Open That Egg
1418.desc: Your shields will detonate on expiration.

1420.name: Sonata
1420.desc:
Every 10 seconds, automatically cast the Aria of Perseverence and Song of Celerity in an alternating melody.

Aria of Perseverence heals nearby allies and grants a temporary shielding aura.

Song of Celerity grants a temporary aura that provides bonus Movement Speed.

1421.name: Prom Queen
1421.desc: Every 35 seconds, <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a sparkly tiara descends upon you. When it lands, gain Rakan's Ultimate, charming enemies you touch.

1424.desc: Your <passive>Missing Pings</passive> will launch a missile at the pinged location that <magicdamage>damages</magicdamage> enemies and <heal>heals</heal> allies.

1996.name: Upgrade Sheen
1996.desc: Your <passive>Spellblade</passive> effects deal <physical>additional damage</physical> and <heal>heal</heal> you for a percent of the target's health. Additionally, gain <gold>250 Gold</gold>.

2001.name: Heads Up Cupcake!
2001.desc: Cupcakes will intermittently fly across the bridge. Cupcakes grant Gold to whoever catches them and restore <healing>Health</healing> to the first champion hit plus their nearby allies. Gain Gold based on the amount healed.

2002.name: Void Rift
2002.desc: Damaging enemies with Abilities creates a Void scar. If there is another Void scar nearby, both are consumed to create a rift between them, dealing <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> enemies inside.

2003.name: Bounce of the Poro King
2003.desc:
Gain Bounce of the Poro King!

Bounce of the Poro King: Transform into the Poro King, bouncing repeatedly, dealing physical damage and Knocking Back nearby enemies.

2004.name: Empowered By The Faithful
2004.desc:
Healing or Shielding allies blesses them, causing their damage to fill you with devotion.

When you have enough devotion, unleash a shockwave dealing magic damage and executes low health enemies.

2005.name: Triggered Inferno
2005.desc: Gain <spellName>Daredevil Impulse</spellName>. When you reach S <keywordMajor>Style</keywordMajor>, automatically use <spellName>Inferno Trigger</spellName>.

2006.name: Dropkick
2006.desc: Your Attacks and Abilities execute low Health enemy champions, Knocking Back and causing an explosion while healing you.

2007.name: Devil on Your Shoulder
2007.desc:
Forge a pact with The Little Devil himself.

He drains your life over time but rewards by applying bonus true damage against champions and creating healing remnants for you to acquire.

2008.name: Weighted Popoffs
2008.desc: Striking enemies with Abilities grants you stacks of <keyword>Popoff</keyword>, reducing your non-Ultimate Ability Cooldowns.

2009.name: Zealot
2009.desc: Gain <attention>(25% + 5%%i:scaleAP%) Critical Strike Chance</attention> and <attackSpeed>(35% + 5%%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed</attackSpeed>.

2010.name: Double Tap
2010.desc:
Your Critical Strikes apply %i:OnHit% On-Hit effects an additional time.

Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% Crit chance.

2016.name: Juiced
2016.desc: <OnHit>%i:OnHit% On-Hit</OnHit> deal <magicDamage>7%%i:scaleMana% magic damage</magicDamage>, this damage can <crit>Critically Strike</crit>.

2018.name: Purist - Caster
2018.desc: Gain percent cooldown reduction and convert all of your <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> into Ability Haste.

2024.name: Crit 'n Cast
2024.desc: Gain Ability Haste equal to 40% of your <crit>%i:scaleCrit% Critical Strike Chance</crit>.

2026.name: Kill Secured
2026.desc: Gain increased <speed>Movement Speed</speed> towards enemies at low Health.

12317.name: Pandora's Box
12317.desc: Transmute all of your augments into <keywordMajor>random Prismatic%i:Augment% Augments</keywordMajor>.
